principles: Use rounded marketing totals such as 80+, 240K+, 160+ where exact counts are brittle or unnecessarily precise.
Keep exact structural facts where precision matters: 54-person organization, 7 direct reports, EGP 150M budget, EGP 11M integration, dated career periods, and governed workflow step counts.
Keep exact UI/filter counts when they describe the current directory structure, except the requested project total which is now presented as 80+.
Use evidence-safe contribution language for project/team work and avoid sole-ownership wording where not explicitly supported.
